t: Founded in 1205 by French crusaders, it was the most durable Latin state created in Greece after the Fourth Crusade.
A model feudal society of twelve baronies, its customs were codified in the Assizes of Romania.
Defeat at Pelagonia in 1259 cost it Mistras, the base from which Byzantium reconquered the Peloponnese by 1432.
dyk: The Venetian writer Marino Sanudo Torsello reported that at the princes’ court in the Peloponnese French was spoken as well as in Paris.
ev: Crusaders defeat the Greeks at the Olive Grove of Koundouros
Geoffrey I is recognised as a vassal of the Latin emperor at Ravennika
William II takes Monemvasia, completing the conquest of the Peloponnese
William II is captured at the Battle of Pelagonia
Mistras, Monemvasia and Grand Magne are ceded to Byzantium
The Treaty of Viterbo places Achaea under Charles of Anjou
Ferdinand of Majorca is killed at the Battle of Manolada
Thomas Palaiologos annexes the last of the principality

f.founder: William of Champlitte and Geoffrey I of Villehardouin
